chunks: When he reached the prime of life We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus We reward those who are good.

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: those who do good / the righteous

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God giving wisdom and knowledge to the righteous?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition of Prophet Joseph (AS) from prophetic potential to active leadership, emphasizing that divine wisdom (hukm) and knowledge ('ilm) are granted upon reaching full maturity (ashudd). It underscores the principle that God rewards the righteous (muhsinin) not only with spiritual grace but also with the practical capacity to govern and judge, a concept central to the Imamate's authority. This bestowal serves as a precedent for the divine selection of leaders who possess both deep insight and administrative competence.
